messages:
Aisha Noor: Hey team — I'm submitting my formal resignation today. My last working day will be 2026-05-15. I'm on company-sponsored Tier 2 visa and remote for my final week. Need to coordinate COBRA/benefits end date, visa sponsorship handoff, SSO/KMS deprovision, laptop return, and final payroll checklist. Who should I loop in?

Janelle (People Ops): Sorry to see you go, Aisha. I'll own the People Ops side. We'll send the exit packet and COBRA info. Quick Q: do you want the COBRA packet sent to your personal email or a secondary?

Ravi Shah: Thanks for the heads up Aisha. Please sketch a short list of in-flight projects and key contacts — I'll set up two handover sessions. Also confirm any client-facing credentials.

Tom - IT: We can arrange prepaid shipping for laptop return or a local dropoff if you prefer. Also need to know which KMS keys/service accounts to revoke. I can start a ticket once we have the asset list.

Lena (Payroll): Final paycheck and accrued PTO payout will be processed on the next payroll run after termination. We need the clearance form signed by 2026-05-18 to avoid delays. COBRA default: coverage ends 2026-05-15 and employee has 60 days to enroll; I'll confirm specifics in the packet.

Aisha Noor: Thanks. KMS keys I used: `project-redwood-prod`, `analytics-embeds`. I also have a client SSO token for client-x and a personal sponsorship letter request for immigration. Please LMK how long COBRA lasts if I enroll.

Janelle (People Ops): COBRA notice is automatic. Coverage loss date is 05/15; enrollment window is 60 days from notice. We'll send an enrollment packet to your personal email unless you'd like it to HR@redwood instead. We'll also draft a termination confirmation letter for immigration — DM me your preferred mailing address.

PeopleOpsBot: Offboarding checklist created: https://okta.redwood/offboard/1768819999 — items will be assigned and tracked.

Ravi Shah: Can we schedule two KT blocks next Tue (2026-05-05) 10:00-12:00 PT? I'll take embed-ingest and client handoffs.

Aisha Noor: Tue 10:00 PT works. For the client token: ID is `client-x-token-7b3`. I think we need client approval to rotate — @Tom - IT and @Ravi Shah please coordinate.

Tom - IT: For client tokens we need a ticket and written client approval. Paste token ID in the ticket and I'll request rotation and replacement. I'll also prep a shipping label for the laptop and email it to you.

Dmitri (Security): Heads up — before we revoke KMS keys we should rotate any dependent service principals. Who owns the `embed-ingest` lambda?

Aisha Noor: Owner is @Ravi Shah. Quick runbook snippet to copy into KT doc: ```service: embed-ingest
owners: ravi
rotate: monthly
creds: use-kms: project-redwood-prod
notes: downstream consumers: analytics-pipeline, realtime-ingest```

Ravi Shah: I'll add the rotation to our ops calendar and own immediate rotation. Janelle — we'll need a 48h buffer before KMS revocation to ensure we're not breaking prod.

Janelle (People Ops): Proposed timeline: 2026-05-16 rotate creds + handover complete, 2026-05-18 revoke KMS & deprovision SSO, 2026-05-20 laptop pickup/shipping completed. Does that align with payroll/IT/security needs?

Tom - IT: That timeline works. I'll open IT ticket PRJ-5421 and assign shipping. Expect label/email by EOD tomorrow.

Lena (Payroll): Confirmed — clearance by 05/18 to include final pay on next run. If anything slips we'll coordinate off-cycle adjustments.

Aisha Noor: Appreciate it. One more ask: can People Ops provide a letter confirming end date + role for immigration? I might need it for local authorities.

Janelle (People Ops): Yes — we'll generate a termination confirmation letter and send it to your DM or mailing address. Please DM me the preferred contact.

PeopleOpsBot: Action items assigned: Janelle (send exit packet + termination letter), Tom - IT (open ticket PRJ-5421 + shipping label), Ravi Shah (KT + rotate embed-ingest creds), Lena (confirm final payroll & COBRA packet), Dmitri (advise on rotation plan).

Ravi Shah: Adding calendar invites for KT and a 30-min exit interview slot. Thanks Aisha, let us know if you want any overlap time with your successor for shadowing.

Aisha Noor: Thanks everyone. I'll post the KT doc link in this thread once it's ready and DM Janelle my address. Really appreciate the smooth plan. :)
